selection_rules.exact: An exact candidate must first be comparable to an independently approved canonical proposition and then preserve every CM datum/type, reflex construction, idelic quotient, Artin normalization, canonical model/level, special-point action, variance, equality convention, binder, hypothesis, and boundary case, or supply a checked transport.
selection_rules.supporting: CM fields, adeles, idele-class scaffolding, schemes, class formations, and abstract statement shapes are substrate only and receive no root proof credit.
selection_rules.placeholder: A body using sorry, admit, sorryAx, unapproved axioms, unsafe code, external oracles, or a circular assumed reciprocity field is M5 for root-credit purposes.
selection_rules.negative_evidence: Each lane identifies its query or source, immutable revision or content-bound repository observation, access boundary, and reopen condition. An access-limited result is not global nonexistence.
selection_rules.deduplication: Aliases, wrappers, statement shapes, and records sharing one terminal body are counted once and never manufacture additional proof coverage.

access_credentials_policy: No credentials and no network access are used by worker replay. Existing tracked observations and manifest-pinned package sources are read-only evidence; unavailable remote bytes are classified as an access boundary rather than silently refreshed.
expected_negative_result_evidence: A content-bound local source or tracked immutable audit record plus the query family, observation date, access limitation, result, and concrete reopen condition.
network_policy: denied for worker replay; no clone, fetch, update, dependency build, or moving-ref query is part of this inventory version
immutable_refresh_policy: A newly supplied exact source theorem, changed target convention, new immutable formal candidate, changed dependency pin, or stronger archived response creates a new append-only inventory version and invalidates this one.
